label: All four routers carry router_state: active and skill_pointer: SKILL.md, the two frontmatter fields check_hub.py pins, so any restructure keeps them byte-identical.
None of the four has a MACHINE ROUTER heading: three hold the fence under ## 2. SMART ROUTING and the Product Owner hub under ## 3. MACHINE-READABLE ROUTER, so all four fail the destination rule.
The Product Owner machine block is followed by ## 4. HOW TO READ THIS and ## RELATED RESOURCES, so renaming its heading would not make it final; the block must move past the prose.
The three Moneybird routers mix prose and machine text inside one heading, so each needs a section split rather than a rename.
check-route-table.py --write regenerates the router block in ROUTER.md, so the generator must emit the new heading or a hand edit reverts on its next run.
The pointer half of the canon is already satisfied in exactly four skills (cli-jortt 45, cli-moneybird 47, sk-moneybird-accountant 42, Product Owner 38) and absent in the other twelve.

Removable machine mass per skill at 1.33 tokens per word: copywriter 3709, sales-hubspot 2648, prompt-improver 1785, mcp-figma 1595, sales-communication 1535, deal-templates 1333, mcp-click-up 1305, create-figjam 1242, mcp-code-mode 1032, sk-product-owner 543, Product Owner hub 394, media-editor 343; about 17460 in total against about 12 pointer lines.
No Claude Project has a routing knowledge document; knowledge files follow <System> - <Section> - <Title>.md, so the Project side of the move is authoring, not a rewrite.
A Project cannot follow the pointer: it sees text, not a sibling path, so the only way it receives a router is a knowledge file that repeats it.

label: Recommended for REQ-003: one new versionless knowledge doc per System, e.g. Sales Direct Communication - System - Routing.md, holding the MACHINE ROUTER payload verbatim, with the kernel reduced to a pointer plus its interlock rules and a dated parity note in SYNC.md.

Collision risk is concentrated in Product Owner: the working tree is clean apart from two untracked Product Context files, but Product Owner took commits on 2026-10-28 while Moneybird has none in 21 days and its SKILL.md mtimes are 2026-10-18.

Migration order: Media Editor pilot, Prompt Improver, Barter - Copywriter, Sales - Direct Communication with its differential gate, Sales - HubSpot & Automation, Barter - Deal Templates with its differential gate and kernel copy, the Moneybird cluster with the generator before the hand edit, and the Product Owner cluster last.

Two gate edits must precede step one: check_hub.py must stop listing packet ROUTER.md as residue and read a packet machine section, and both differential.py prose guards must slice the routing prose from wherever it lands.
